query:
INSERT INTO federation_laboratory_trusts (
            trust_id,
            local_laboratory_id,
            remote_node_id,
            remote_laboratory_id,
            remote_laboratory_name,
            created_by_user_id
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (local_laboratory_id, remote_node_id, remote_laboratory_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            remote_laboratory_name = EXCLUDED.remote_laboratory_name,
            status = 'active',
            revoked_at = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        RETURNING
            trust_id,
            local_laboratory_id,
            remote_node_id,
            remote_laboratory_id,
            remote_laboratory_name,
            status,
            created_at,
            updated_at,
            revoked_at
